title: 鋼軌鋁熱焊接
summary: 鋼軌鋁熱焊接以「現場接頭熱量收縮形貌與無損檢測」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。鋁熱焊課程只分析接頭能量、凝固收縮與焊後驗證；化學配方、點火及現場操作均不由教學模型指定，重點是辨認外觀與內部品質的差異。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops field-joint heat shrinkage profile and nondestructive inspection through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. This aluminothermic-weld course analyses joint energy, solidification shrinkage and post-weld verification; it specifies no chemical recipe, ignition or field procedure, and distinguishes visible profile from internal quality. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 接頭金屬質量與接頭顯熱量級
stages.titleEn: Joint metal mass & Joint sensible-heat scale
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「接頭金屬質量」與「接頭顯熱量級」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Joint metal mass" and "Joint sensible-heat scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 接頭金屬質量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint metal mass: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接頭金屬質量」如何影響鋼軌鋁熱焊接的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint metal mass” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Aluminothermic rail welding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 密度乘有效體積可核對材料帳，外部餘料需分開。本模型把 rho 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 6.864 kg。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。有效體積與密度對應同一溫度狀態；不含外部餘料。使用接頭幾何與有效體積作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；外部餘料混入有效體積會高估接頭補入量，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接頭金屬質量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Density times effective volume checks the material account, keeping external surplus separate. In this model, rho is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 6.864 kg. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Effective volume and density refer to the same temperature state; external surplus is excluded. Use joint geometry and effective volume as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Including surplus in effective volume overstates useful joint fill; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint metal mass” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：rho=7800 kg/m3, V=0.0008 m3；y=rho*V=6.24 kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: rho=7800 kg/m3, V=0.0008 m3; y=rho*V=6.24 kg.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：外部餘料混入有效體積會高估接頭補入量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Including surplus in effective volume overstates useful joint fill." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「接頭金屬質量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Joint metal mass”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接頭金屬質量
knowledge.text: 密度乘有效體積可核對材料帳，外部餘料需分開。本模型把 rho 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 6.864 kg。
knowledge.textEn: Density times effective volume checks the material account, keeping external surplus separate. In this model, rho is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：外部餘料混入有效體積會高估接頭補入量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Including surplus in effective volume overstates useful joint fill. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「鋼軌鋁熱焊接」的「接頭金屬質量：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出車輛、軌道、牽引供電、號誌與旅客的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「軌道量測夜班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與版本一致的速度、時間、位置、負載及控制紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Joint metal mass: mechanism and system paths” in “Aluminothermic rail welding”. Draw the vehicle, track, traction, signaling and passenger interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Track metrology night shift” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for version-aligned speed, time, position, load and control records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「接頭金屬質量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint metal mass" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：外部餘料混入有效體積會高估接頭補入量
密度乘有效體積可核對材料帳，外部餘料需分開。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略潛熱會誤判冷卻時間
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Including surplus in effective volume overstates useful joint fill.
Density times effective volume checks the material account, keeping external surplus separate.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Omitting latent heat misjudges cooling duration.
quiz.explanation: 密度乘有效體積可核對材料帳，外部餘料需分開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Density times effective volume checks the material account, keeping external surplus separate. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 接頭金屬質量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint metal mass: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接頭金屬質量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint metal mass” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：rho=7800 kg/m3, V=0.0008 m3；y=rho*V=6.24 kg。只把 rho 增加百分之十，y=6.864 kg。模型邊界：有效體積與密度對應同一溫度狀態；不含外部餘料；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: rho=7800 kg/m3, V=0.0008 m3; y=rho*V=6.24 kg. Increasing only rho with a ten-percent increase gives y=6.864 kg. Boundary: Effective volume and density refer to the same temperature state; external surplus is excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以接頭幾何與有效體積區分模型與觀察，先用接頭模型三維體積、密度資料及獨立秤重建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use joint geometry and effective volume to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：rho=7800 kg/m3, V=0.0008 m3；y=rho*V=6.24 kg。只把 rho 增加百分之十，y=6.864 kg。模型邊界：有效體積與密度對應同一溫度狀態；不含外部餘料；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

Boundary: Effective volume and density refer to the same temperature state; external surplus is excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「接頭金屬質量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Joint metal mass", which statement holds?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：冷卻不均可能把收縮集中成缺陷

This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Extending a steady flux over the entire cooling history distorts energy.

quiz.explanationEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: rho=7800 kg/m3, V=0.0008 m3; y=rho*V=6.24 kg. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 接頭金屬質量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joint metal mass: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接頭金屬質量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint metal mass” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以接頭幾何與有效體積區分模型與觀察，先用接頭模型三維體積、密度資料及獨立秤重建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「接頭金屬質量」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use joint geometry and effective volume to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using three-dimensional joint-model volume, density data and independent weighing, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Joint metal mass. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「接頭金屬質量」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出有效體積與密度對應同一溫度狀態；不含外部餘料如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由外部餘料混入有效體積會高估接頭補入量造成偏離的合成觀察，以接頭幾何與有效體積說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Joint metal mass, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Effective volume and density refer to the same temperature state; external surplus is excluded. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Including surplus in effective volume overstates useful joint fill. Explain which evidence in joint geometry and effective volume distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：外部餘料混入有效體積會高估接頭補入量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Including surplus in effective volume overstates useful joint fill. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「接頭金屬質量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Joint metal mass"?
options: 本單元以接頭幾何與有效體積區分模型與觀察，先用接頭模型三維體積、密度資料及獨立秤重建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

quiz.explanationEn: Use joint geometry and effective volume to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 接頭金屬質量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joint metal mass: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接頭金屬質量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint metal mass” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 外部餘料混入有效體積會高估接頭補入量。這個失效與「接頭金屬質量」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查接頭幾何與有效體積，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Including surplus in effective volume overstates useful joint fill. This failure and a measurement bias in Joint metal mass can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check joint geometry and effective volume rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. steps.observation: 連結機制：使用質量與溫度歷程作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略潛熱會誤判冷卻時間，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Omitting latent heat misjudges cooling duration; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略潛熱會誤判冷卻時間」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Omitting latent heat misjudges cooling duration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略潛熱會誤判冷卻時間。這個失效與「接頭顯熱量級」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查質量與溫度歷程，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Omitting latent heat misjudges cooling duration. This failure and a measurement bias in Joint sensible-heat scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check mass and temperature history rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「接頭顯熱量級」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Joint sensible-heat scale" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把平台當成感測器故障會漏掉相變效應
忽略潛熱會誤判冷卻時間。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Mistaking a plateau for sensor failure misses phase-change behavior.
Omitting latent heat misjudges cooling duration.
quiz.explanation: 忽略潛熱會誤判冷卻時間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitting latent heat misjudges cooling duration. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
